overview: Agentic AI usage expands in EU enterprises but remains uneven across countries
OpenAI faces multi‑state lawsuits alleging unsafe ChatGPT for minors

top.title: How Third Moment Research runs 10,000 agents for 36+ hours
top.summary: Third Moment Research uses OpenAI’s GPT‑6 models and Codex to run 10,000 agents for up to 48 hours, auto‑generating synthetic scenarios to improve agent performance, notably cutting quantitative‑finance backtesting from hours to minutes.

top.title: The EU’s next chapter in AI is agentic
top.summary: OpenAI’s EU report shows agentic tools like Codex and ChatGPT Work now generate over half of enterprise token output, with adoption varying widely between countries and firms lagging global frontiers.

top.title: Eight states sue OpenAI, saying ChatGPT isn’t safe for kids
top.summary: Eight US states sued OpenAI, claiming ChatGPT is marketed as safe for youth despite alleged harms, insufficient age protections, and data collection from minors, seeking penalties and data deletion.

top.title: Researchers use AI to design proteins that cut up other proteins
top.summary: Scientists used AI protein‑design tools to create novel proteases by swapping catalytic cores, enabling enzymes that precisely cleave disease‑linked proteins, demonstrating AI’s potential in therapeutic enzyme engineering.

top.title: How Tamnoon built AI-powered cloud security remediation with Amazon Bedrock
top.summary: Tamnoon built Tami, an agentic remediation system on Amazon Bedrock that autonomously investigates, prioritizes, and safely fixes cloud security findings, reducing critical exposures by over 90 % in three months.

top.title: AI Models Can Be Easily Modified to Assist Terrorist and Extremist Activity
top.summary: Abliterated versions of Alibaba’s open‑weight Qwen model were quickly repurposed for extremist chatbots, highlighting how easy removal of guardrails lets malicious actors adapt AI for terrorist content.
